renderings: so that we do not drift away

G3927.definition: παρ-επί-δημος, -ον; (see: ἐπιδημέω),  ; sojourning in a strange place; as subst., ὁ π., a sojourner: of Christians, 1Pe.1:1; ξένοι καὶ π., Heb.11:13; πάροικοι καὶ π., 1Pe.2:11 (see Deiss., BS, 149).†; (AS)

G3984.definition: (πειράω),  ; trial, experiment; π. λαμβάνειν, to make trial, have experience of: Heb.11:29, 36 (for exx., see Field, Notes, 232 f.).†; (AS)

G3970.definition: πατρο-παρά-δοτος, -ον; (πατήρ, παραδίδωμι), ; handed down from one's fathers, inherited: 1Pe.1:18 (Diod., al.).†; (AS)

G3923.definition: παρ-εισ-φέρω ; to bring in or supply besides: σπουδὴν π. (late Gk. for cl. σ. ποιεῖσθαι; cf. Deiss., BS, 361), 2Pe.1:5.†; (AS)

G3919.definition: παρ-εισ-άγω ; 1. to lead in by one's side, bring forward, introduce. ; 2. In late writers, to introduce or bring in secretly: 2Pe.2:1.†; (AS)

G3921.definition: παρ-εισ-δύω; (also -δύνω), ; to slip in secretly, steal in: παρεισεδύησαν (vulgar aor.; pass. for act., El., § 19, 2), Ju 4 (cf. also MM, xix).†; (AS)

G3963.definition: Patmos, an island in the Ægean Sea: Rev.1:9.†; (AS)

G3990.definition: (πέλεκυς, a battle-axe), ; to out off with an axe, esp. to behead: with accusative, Rev.20:4 (Polyb., al.).†; (AS)
